description: This Java class 'SavingsAccountAssembler' is responsible for constructing and assembling 'SavingsAccount' objects from JSON input, repository data, and product details within the Fineract microfinance platform. It handles creating new savings accounts, loading transactions, and populating data objects, while ensuring validation and business rules are applied.

classes.name: SavingsAccountAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for creating and populating SavingsAccount instances from JSON commands or existing data, applying business rules, and linking related entities.

methods.name: assembleFrom
methods.description: Constructs a new SavingsAccount from JSON input, validating and inheriting details based on provided parameters and product specifications.

methods.name: assembleFrom
methods.description: Loads a SavingsAccount with its transactions based on account ID, optionally allowing backdated transactions.

methods.name: loadTransactionsToSavingsAccount
methods.description: Populates a SavingsAccount with its transaction history, optionally considering pivot date constraints.

methods.name: assembleSavings
methods.description: Converts a SavingsAccount object into its corresponding data transfer object for API responses.

methods.name: assembleFrom
methods.description: Creates a new SavingsAccount application from client, group, product, date, and user info, for manual creation scenarios.

methods.name: assignSavingAccountHelpers
methods.description: Assigns helper objects to a SavingsAccount for transaction summaries.

methods.description: Assigns helper objects to a SavingsAccountData for transaction summaries.
